metadata.title: Is it plausible to expect a close encounter of the Earth with a yet undiscovered astronomical object in the next few years?

notes: No roster entry is warranted. The paper's analyzed body X is hypothetical and unidentified, and its unbound condition is with respect to the Sun rather than an explicit Galactic-unbound claim (T:p2-b1). HE 0437−5439 is only an illustrative known HVS in a literature review and is not itself the subject of a follow-up analysis (T:p3-b2). RX J0822−4300 is fast but is not explicitly stated to be Galactic unbound (T:p3-b3). Gl 229B, Cha 110913−773444, and rho Oph 4450 are background substellar examples, not unbound candidates (T:p4-b0); V404 Cyg and V4641 Sgr are black-hole binaries, not unbound stars (T:p7-b5). The "16" unbound objects are not individually identified, so the group statement cannot generate roster entries (T:p3-b2).
